reason: Boron microalloying is the more physically targeted intervention: trace grain-boundary segregation can improve cohesion and crack resistance with less risk of disrupting the composition-sensitive magnetostructural transition than 1–2 at.% Zr, whose lattice distortion and potentially brittle intermetallics may increase strength without improving toughness. Both proposals lack explicit field, pressure, temperature, and loading limits and system-specific evidence, but B offers the more plausible integrity-preserving mechanism and a controlled caloric/mechanical comparison.
